name: Cubes in the Mountains WV 2025

venue.name: Wiles Hill Community Center
venue.details: Follow signs, competition will be in Gym

information:
This is the first competition in the Morgantown area since 2011!

There is a limit of **1 guest** per competitor. 
-
​
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdmhSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--870d76ef713f4edc5223895d9e286e7c18138874/Mid_Atlantic_Logo.png)
​
This competition is being held in the Mid-Atlantic Region (DC, DE, MD, NJ, NY, PA, VA, WV). See the regions on [CubingUSA's website](https://cubingusa.org/regional). 
​
- Join the **[Mid-Atlantic Speedcubing Discord server](https://discord.gg/vpvSv5hfmX)**
- Join the **[Tri-State Cubing Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/265800827296908/)** (NJ, NY, PA)
- See the **[Mid-Atlantic Region Organizational Spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a-IPbJv1fA5rsijUHZYLqQmMqnv0Osw8JO0sQMMAWyQ/edit)**
- See upcoming competitions:
  - in **[Delaware](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=delaware&show_registration_status=on)**
